## ✨ About

**Kiru Music** is a fast, modern, and fully-loaded Telegram voice-chat music bot — rebuilt and refreshed for the **2025-26** cycle. Stream high-quality audio and video straight into your group's voice chat with a smooth, reliable experience.

### 🌟 Key Features

- 🎧 High-quality audio/video streaming
- ⚡ Fast and stable performance
- 🎶 Playback support from YouTube, Spotify, and more
- 📃 Playlist and queue management
- 🛠️ Easy deployment (Heroku / VPS both supported)
- 🔄 Regular updates and active support

## 🚀 Deploy

### One-Click Deploy on Heroku

<div align="center">
<a href="https://dashboard.heroku.com/new?template=https://github.com/KIRU-OP/KIRU-MUSIC">
<img src="https://img.shields.io/badge/DEPLOY%20ON%20HEROKU-8A2BE2?style=for-the-badge&logo=heroku&logoColor=white" width="240"/>
</a>
</div>

### Manual Deploy — VPS / Local Host

| Step | Command |
|------|---------|
| 1️⃣ Get your variables | [sample.env](https://github.com/KIRU-OP/KIRU-MUSIC/blob/master/sample.env) |
| 2️⃣ Update system | `sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get upgrade -y` |
| 3️⃣ Install FFmpeg | `sudo apt-get install python3-pip ffmpeg -y` |
| 4️⃣ Install pip | `sudo pip3 install -U pip` |
| 5️⃣ Install Node.js | `curl -fssL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_18.x \| sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install nodejs -y && npm i -g npm` |
| 6️⃣ Clone the repo | `git clone https://github.com/KIRU-OP/KIRU-MUSIC && cd KIRU-MUSIC` |
| 7️⃣ Install requirements | `pip3 install -U -r requirements.txt` |
| 8️⃣ Configure env | `vi sample.env` → press `I` to edit → `Ctrl+C` then `:wq` to save |
| 9️⃣ Rename env file | `mv sample.env .env` |
| 🔟 Install tmux | `sudo apt install tmux && tmux` |
| ▶️ Run the bot | `bash start` |

> 💡 **Tip:** To exit a tmux session without stopping the bot, press `Ctrl+b`, then `d`
